checks.name: always-on floor replaces the vampire-load button
always-on floor modal states kWh/day, $/yr and the ~10% benchmark
checks.detail: WHAT IS THE ALWAYS-ON FLOOR? THE FLOOR IS THE SLICE OF YOUR BILL THAT NEVER SWITCHES OFF — THE FRIDGE, THE CHARGERS, THE CLOCKS, THE STANDBY LIGHTS. IT IS THERE WHETHER YOU ARE HOME OR NOT, AND IT IS THE ONE PART OF THE BILL YOU CAN ACTUALLY SWITCH. HOW WE MEASURE YOURS: WE LOOK AT YOUR WHOLE VISIBLE WINDOW AND TAKE THE LOWEST 5% OF HOURLY READINGS — THE HOURS WHEN NOTHING SHOULD HAVE BEEN RUNNING. THOSE HOURS AVERAGE 1510 WATTS, ABOUT 36.2 KWH A DAY. PRICED AT YOUR BLENDED 12.5¢/KWH, THAT IS $1656 A YEAR OF NEVER-OFF ENERGY. COMMUNITY BENCHMARK IS ABOUT 10% OF THE BILL — YOURS WORKS OUT AT 46% (ABOVE IT, WORTH A PLUG-HUNT). COSTS ARE COMMODITY (VARIABLE) CHARGES ONLY — NO DELIVERY, REGULATO
